entities.summary: Masjid Ahmad is a mosque located along Lorong Sarhad in South Buona Vista, within the larger planning area of Queenstown, Singapore. It was built in 1934 and named for Ahmad Yahya, who was its main benefactor. Originating as a small surau, the present-day building is a larger 21st century reconstruction.
